archival_memory.patient_medical_history: Over the years, I’ve been on quite a few medications and treatments to manage my health. Between diabetes, hypertension, osteoarthritis, and hypothyroidism, I’ve had to adjust my meds a few times to find what works best. I always make sure to keep track of everything so I don’t miss a dose or mix up any prescriptions. My doctor and I review my meds every few months to see if any adjustments are needed.
archival_memory.medication_management_strategies: pill planner and use reminders on my phone, focus on lifestyle changes to avoid unnecessary prescriptions
